pull_requests.title: feat: Deprecate AWS SDK v1 – replace with boto3 v2 adapter
pull_requests.author: vikram_patel
pull_requests.description: This PR removes all AWS SDK v1 usage from the authentication-service and api-gateway. Replaces with boto3 v2 compatible adapter layer to prepare for eventual GCP migration. Deprecated: S3Client_v1, SQSClient_v1.

commits.author: vikram_patel
commits.message: chore: remove deprecated AWS SDK v1 imports from auth-service

commits.author: vikram_patel
commits.message: feat: implement boto3 v2 adapter for S3 operations in auth-service

commits.author: vikram_patel
commits.message: test: add unit tests for boto3 v2 adapter layer

review_comments.author: arun_sharma
review_comments.body: Good work Vikram. The adapter pattern here is solid – it will make the eventual GCP migration much cleaner since we can swap boto3 calls for GCS equivalents. LGTM but please add a deprecation warning in the old entry-points.

review_comments.author: rohan_mehta
review_comments.body: Approved. This is exactly the abstraction we need for the GCP migration. The boto3 v2 adapter decouples our code from AWS-specific APIs nicely.

pull_requests.title: fix: JWT race condition in token rotation – use Redis distributed lock
pull_requests.author: vikram_patel
pull_requests.description: Critical security fix for SEC-055. The JWT secret rotation had a race condition where two concurrent requests could both read the old secret during rotation. Fixed with Redis distributed locking (Redlock algorithm) to ensure atomic token rotation.

commits.author: vikram_patel
commits.message: fix(auth): implement Redlock distributed lock for JWT secret rotation

commits.author: vikram_patel
commits.message: test(auth): add concurrent token rotation integration tests

review_comments.author: divya_krishnan
review_comments.body: Excellent fix Vikram. The Redlock implementation is correct. Lock TTL of 5s is appropriate. I've verified the fix against the race condition I originally identified in SEC-055. Approved.

review_comments.author: rohan_mehta
review_comments.body: LGTM. Redis dependency is already in our stack. One note: ensure Redis connection pool is sized correctly for GKE pod autoscaling.

pull_requests.title: feat: Introduce GCP SDK (google-cloud-storage) – replace AWS S3 in auth-service
pull_requests.author: rohan_mehta
pull_requests.description: Phase 1 GCP migration: replaces all AWS S3 usage in authentication-service with Google Cloud Storage (GCS). Removes boto3 dependency from auth-service module. Adds google-cloud-storage to requirements. Implements GCS-backed credential storage and session artifact storage.

commits.author: rohan_mehta
commits.message: feat(auth): add GCS client wrapper for credential storage

commits.author: rohan_mehta
commits.message: chore(auth): remove boto3 dependency, add google-cloud-storage>=2.10.0

commits.author: rohan_mehta
commits.message: refactor(auth): migrate session artifact storage from S3 to GCS

commits.author: rohan_mehta
commits.message: test: comprehensive integration tests for GCS storage layer

review_comments.author: arun_sharma
review_comments.body: This is the PR we've been working towards. GCS migration looks clean. Rohan you've implemented this exactly as the architecture decision specified. My one concern: make sure we have a rollback plan documented in JIRA before merging.

review_comments.author: priya_nair
review_comments.body: I was skeptical of this migration but the implementation quality is high. The GCS client wrapper is well-abstracted. Approved.

review_comments.author: vikram_patel
review_comments.body: LGTM. The GCS IAM role setup in the deployment manifests looks correct. Approved.
